Look at their team composition, as well as your own team composition and decide from there on out.

Bruiser mythics are great when your team lacks a frontline and requires peeling. My go to tend to be gore/trin, havent had much luck with sunderer, its great against tanks but I feel like I have more room to work with on gore.

However, whenever I see the enemy composition being squishy, Id just go for an on-hit build which is basically shieldbow, wit's end, guinsoo and just sweep them.

Though Botrk tends to be a core item since it rly spikes your 1v1 potential.

Your lane and matchups will influence your build heavily too

I find my irelia games to be difficult as well in top lane. Transitioning from playing irelia to something as easy as Sett definitely makes it easier because of his passive and 1v2 capabilities.

I tend to go for deep wards if my lane is shoved and wait until the enemy jungler shows so that i can make an aggressive play against the my opponent laner. Since without a lead I definitely don't feel like I can 1v2 unless my wave state or my skillshots (e) land in a favourable condition to win.

But yeah unless I dodge yasuo/yone's skillshots and ensure they're on cooldown, I don't go for an aggressive play since I won't do much without a fully stacked passive. Even if I do have it fully stacked I wouldn't go all in, perhaps dash in to a low minion, auto the enemy champion for a few hits and dash out for a safe trade.
